name: Ethylene oxide and glycols
principle: Ethylene is oxidised with oxygen over a silver catalyst to ethylene oxide, which is hydrated to ethylene glycols. High-selectivity catalysts reached 90% or more start-of-cycle selectivity, and a two-step catalytic route via ethylene carbonate (Shell OMEGA) gives more than 99% MEG against 90 to 92% for thermal hydration.

performance.basis: start of cycle: early HS at least 86%, later HS 90% or more; HP averaged about 87% in one plant

source.note: Shell Catalysts & Technologies, Enhancements in EO/EG manufacturing technology

performance.metric: MEG yield, catalytic two-step versus thermal

source.note: Shell Catalysts & Technologies, Enhancements in EO/EG manufacturing technology

advantages: Catalytic route gives more MEG per EO
limitations: The document does not name OMEGA or give licensed plant counts
